Title: Taxi Driver
Description: A lonely taxi driver in New York City becomes increasingly disturbed by the crime and decay around him.

Title: Demolition
Description: A successful investment banker begins rebuilding his life after a personal tragedy.

Title: Prisoners
Description: A desperate father searches for his missing daughter after the police investigation stalls.

Title: The Godfather
Description: The aging patriarch of an organized crime dynasty transfers control of his empire to his reluctant son.

Title: Interstellar
Description: A group of explorers travel through a wormhole in space to find a new home for humanity.

Title: Inception
Description: A skilled thief who steals secrets through dreams is given a chance to erase his past by performing an impossible task.

Title: The Dark Knight
Description: Batman faces a criminal mastermind who plunges Gotham City into chaos.

Title: The Shawshank Redemption
Description: Two imprisoned men form a friendship over many years and find hope inside a harsh prison system.
